## Scope & Deliverables

### Phase 1: Discovery & Strategy ([X] weeks)

**Deliverables:**
- [ ] Kickoff meeting & alignment
- [ ] Competitive analysis
- [ ] User research (if applicable)
- [ ] Content strategy
- [ ] Information architecture & sitemap
- [ ] Project brief (signed off)

**Your involvement:** High - interviews, feedback, approval

---

### Phase 2: Design ([X] weeks)

**Deliverables:**
- [ ] Wireframes (low-fidelity)
- [ ] Design system basics (colors, typography, components)
- [ ] High-fidelity designs for [X] key pages:
  - Homepage
  - [Page 2]
  - [Page 3]
  - [etc.]
- [ ] Responsive design (mobile, tablet, desktop)
- [ ] Design approval

**Your involvement:** Medium - reviews and feedback (2 rounds included)

---

### Phase 3: Development ([X] weeks)

**Deliverables:**
- [ ] WordPress + Bricks Builder setup
- [ ] All approved pages built
- [ ] Custom functionality:
  - [Feature 1]
  - [Feature 2]
  - [Feature 3]
- [ ] Responsive implementation
- [ ] Performance optimization
- [ ] Browser testing (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)
- [ ] Staging site review

**Your involvement:** Low-Medium - staging review and feedback

---

### Phase 4: Content & Testing ([X] weeks)

**Deliverables:**
- [ ] Content integration/migration
- [ ] SEO optimization:
  - Meta titles & descriptions
  - Header tags optimization
  - XML sitemap
  - Robots.txt
  - Schema markup (where applicable)
- [ ] Quality assurance testing:
  - Functionality testing
  - Cross-browser testing
  - Cross-device testing
  - Performance testing (Core Web Vitals)
  - Accessibility check (WCAG AA)
- [ ] Final client review & approval

**Your involvement:** Medium - content delivery, final approval

---

### Phase 5: Launch & Training ([X] weeks)

**Deliverables:**
- [ ] Pre-launch checklist completion
- [ ] Website deployment
- [ ] DNS/domain configuration
- [ ] SSL certificate setup
- [ ] Search engine submission
- [ ] Live site monitoring
- [ ] Training session (recorded):
  - Content management
  - Bricks Builder basics
  - Plugin overview
  - Best practices
- [ ] Documentation:
  - User guide
  - Video tutorials
  - Maintenance guide
  - Contact information
- [ ] 30-day post-launch support

**Your involvement:** Medium - launch coordination, training attendance

## Terms & Conditions

**Revisions:**
- 2 rounds of revisions included per phase
- Additional revisions: [Amount] PLN per round

**Timeline:**
- Based on timely client feedback (3-5 business days)
- Delays in feedback may extend timeline proportionally

**Content:**
- Client responsible for providing content
- We integrate and optimize provided content
- Copywriting available as add-on

**Ownership:**
- Upon final payment, all work becomes yours
- We retain right to showcase in portfolio (unless otherwise agreed)

**Support:**
- 30 days post-launch support included
- After 30 days, retainer or hourly support available

**Cancellation:**
- Either party may cancel with written notice
- Work completed to date will be billed
- Deposits are non-refundable

**Changes:**
- Scope changes require written change request
- May affect timeline and pricing
- We'll provide estimate before proceeding
